reason: While the simulation is robust and has made substantial progress, several critical issues remain unaddressed, particularly in model realism and alignment with real-world data. Key weaknesses include lack of spatial clustering, simplistic agent behavior (no movement or adaptation), limited validation metrics, and a mismatch in entity count between simulation and evaluation. Since one iteration remains, there is significant potential for impactful improvements by focusing on these areas.

specific_areas: Implement clustered spatial placement of agents to better reflect real-world population structure
Expand agent behavioral model to include movement and/or adaptive contact rates
Enhance validation metrics: add time-varying R0, attack rate, and spatial clustering statistics
Standardize and document population size parameter to ensure consistency with evaluation

result_evaluation.adjustments: Evaluate new metrics (attack rate, time-varying R0, clustering statistics) against real-world data and report improvements in fit. Compare spatial and temporal output with observed patterns.
